🌍 BUILD YOUR EXPERTISE. MASTER THE ART OF MEDIATION. SHAPE THE FUTURE OF DISPUTE RESOLUTION.
MEDARB INTERNATIONAL PRESENTS
⚖️ 40-HOUR PROFESSIONAL MEDIATION TRAINING PROGRAMME
NOW WITH WEEKEND ONLINE CLASSES!
The future of dispute resolution belongs to professionals who can manage conflict, facilitate dialogue, negotiate effectively and guide parties towards meaningful resolutions.
MedArb International invites aspiring mediators, advocates, legal professionals, academicians, corporate professionals, HR practitioners and students to participate in an intensive 40-hour Professional Mediation Training Programme.
WHY JOIN THIS PROGRAMME?
Our structured training combines theoretical foundations with practical learning and professional skill development.
Key learning areas include:
• Introduction to Mediation and ADR
• Understanding Conflict and Conflict Management
• Mediation Process, Stages and Techniques
• Communication and Negotiation Skills
• Ethics and Professional Responsibilities of Mediators
• Practical Training, Simulations and Role-Plays
• Career and Professional Development Opportunities
PROGRAMME FORMAT
📚 40 Hours of Professional Training
💻 Online Weekend Classes
🌐 Experienced Indian and International Faculty
⚖️ Curriculum based on MCPC, Supreme Court of India guidelines
🏅 Certificate of Completion
PROPOSED CLASS SCHEDULE
19, 20, 26, 27 and 28 December 2026
PROGRAMME FEE
Regular Fee: ₹7,500
Early Bird Fee: ₹5,500
WHO SHOULD PARTICIPATE?
Advocates | Law Students | Legal Academicians | Corporate Professionals | HR Professionals | Aspiring Mediators | Dispute Resolution Enthusiasts.
YOUR JOURNEY TOWARDS BECOMING A COMPETENT MEDIATOR BEGINS HERE.
At MedArb International, we believe mediation is not merely an alternative to litigation. It is a professional skill, a transformative process and an essential instrument for building a more collaborative society.
